paragraphs: AudioEye is an industry-leading digital accessibility platform delivering website accessibility compliance at all price points to businesses of all sizes. Our solutions advance accessibility with patented technology that reduces barriers, expands access for individuals with disabilities, and enhances the user experience for a broader audience. We believe that, when implemented, our solution offers businesses and organizations the opportunity to reach more customers, improve brand image, build additional brand loyalty, and, most importantly, provide an accessible and usable web experience to the expansive and ever-growing global population of individuals with disabilities.

AudioEye primarily generates revenue through the sale of subscriptions for our software-as-a-service ("SaaS") accessibility solutions. Our solutions are backed by machine-learning/AI-driven technology that finds and fixes common accessibility errors. Our core and supplemental solutions are designed to help websites and applications achieve and sustain substantial conformance with AudioEye's interpretation of the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines ("WCAG") which are web accessibility standards published by the Web Accessibility Initiative of the World Wide Web Consortium, the main international standards organization for the internet. Our solutions help mitigate a customer's risk of costly digital accessibility-related legal action. AudioEye customers may purchase solutions directly through the AudioEye Marketplace, through a platform partner or an agency, such as Duda, that integrates our solutions into their marketplace, through a vertical Content Management System ("CMS") partner, through an authorized reseller, or by working directly with the AudioEye sales team.

AudioEye stands out among its competitors because it offers automated and human assisted technological fixes and continuous monitoring of accessibility issues without fundamental changes to the website architecture. We recognize that automation alone cannot fix all accessibility issues, which is why we also offer certified accessibility experts, who can provide human assisted technological testing and custom fixes. Our solution is currently trusted by some of the largest and most influential companies in the world, including Samsung, Landry's, Calvin Klein and others. Government agencies, such as the Federal Communications Commission, use our software with their digital platforms. We also work with government agencies at the state and local level.

If not coded properly, a website or application may not offer full access to content or functionality for individuals with disabilities, including users of assistive technology ("AT"), such as a screen reader. As a result, those sites may exclude potential users and customers. As discussed in more detail below, these sites also may not comply with U.S. and foreign laws requiring accessibility and digital inclusion, such as Title III of the Americans with Disabilities Act, Section 508 of the Rehabilitation Act, and California's Unruh Civil Rights Act.

Traditional solutions addressing web accessibility may be costly and difficult to implement. Historically, the process for achieving compliance has been driven by costly consulting services and has not fully utilized emerging technologies to reduce the compliance cost burden or keep up with the fast pace of new content creation. At the same time, web accessibility efforts have generally focused on a limited number of disability use cases, leaving many users' accessibility needs for digital inclusion unaddressed. Businesses may have been reluctant to invest further in web accessibility solutions due to a perceived lack of return on the significant investment required to design and implement a thorough and usable compliance solution.

Other solutions have been developed to help users access websites, but these often require the installation of a plug-in or software on the user's computer. Similarly, some are tailored to either single or a limited number of use cases and lack a holistic approach for addressing compliance and accessibility. Further, some companies focus on automation alone, whereas our solutions take a comprehensive approach involving both technology and experts.

At its core, AudioEye's offering provides ongoing testing, automated fixes, and 24/7 monitoring that continually improves conformance with WCAG. This in turn helps businesses and organizations comply with WCAG standards as well as applicable U.S. and foreign accessibility laws. Our technology is capable of immediately identifying and fixing most of the common accessibility errors and addresses a wide range of disabilities including dyslexia, color blindness, epilepsy and more. AudioEye also offers additional

solutions to provide for enhanced compliance and accessibility, including periodic auditing, custom fixes by experts, and legal support services. Our solutions may be purchased through a subscription service on a month-to-month basis or with one or multi-year terms. We also offer PDF remediation services and mobile application and audit reporting services to help our customers with their digital accessibility needs.
Our current and potential customer base includes a very broad range of private and public sector customers, including:
● Small- and medium-sized businesses; ● Corporate enterprises; ● Non-profit organizations;

● Federal government agencies, whose electronic and information technology must be accessible to people with disabilities, including employees and members of the public, pursuant to Section 508 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973; and
● Federal, state, and local governments and agencies, which often have laws and regulations that require accessibility for people with disabilities.

We manage customers through two primary channels, Enterprise and Partner and Marketplace. Enterprise channel consists of our larger customers and organizations, including those with non-platform custom websites, who generally engage directly with AudioEye sales personnel for custom pricing and solutions. This channel also includes federal, state, and local government agencies. The Partner and Marketplace channel consists of our CMS partners, platform & agency partners, authorized resellers and the Marketplace. This channel serves small and medium sized businesses that are on a partner or reseller's web-hosting platform or that purchase an AudioEye solution from our Marketplace.

We had one major customer (including the customer's affiliates reflecting multiple contracts and a partnership with the Company) which accounted for approximately 13% and 15% of our revenue in the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively.

headings: Risks Relating to Our Business and Industry
We have a history of generating significant losses and may not be able to achieve and sustain profitability.
Weakened global economic conditions including current and ongoing microeconomic uncertainty may adversely affect our industry, business and results of operations.
We are, have been, and may in the future be, party to litigation, which could have a material adverse effect on our financial position or results of operations.
Market interest rates could remain high or continue to increase our interest costs on future debt and could adversely affect our stock price.
Our business plan may not be realized. If our business plan proves to be unsuccessful, our business may fail, and you may lose your entire investment.
Advances in artificial intelligence may intensify competition and reduce demand for our solutions.
If we are not able to adequately protect our patented rights, our operations may be negatively impacted.
The current legal environment for our products and services remains unclear.
If the market for our online services does not grow as anticipated, our business would be adversely affected.
Our success is dependent on our employees, some of whom are relatively new in their positions with the Company.
Our expansion into new products, services, technologies, and geographic regions subjects us to additional business, legal, financial, and competitive risks.
We face risks related to system interruption and lack of redundancy.
Government regulation is evolving, and unfavorable changes could harm our business.
We may be subject to risks related to government contracts and related procurement regulations.
If our products and services do not continue to gain market acceptance, we may not be able to fund future operations.
Our products and services are highly technical and may contain undetected errors, which could cause harm to our reputation and adversely affect our business.
Malfunctions of third-party communications infrastructure, hardware and software expose us to a variety of risks we cannot control, and those risks could result in harm to our business.
Security and privacy breaches, computer viruses, and cyber-attacks could harm our business, financial condition, results of operations, or reputation.
System failure or interruption or our failure to meet increasing demands on our systems could harm our business.
Fraud, impersonation, and social engineering schemes could result in financial loss or reputational harm.
We do not expect to pay any dividends to holders of our common stock for the foreseeable future, which will affect the extent to which our investors realize any future gains on their investment.
We will need to recruit and retain additional qualified personnel to successfully grow our business.
Risks Related to the Market for Our Common Stock

Although our shares of common stock are listed on the Nasdaq Capital Market, historically we have had a limited trading volume and a higher price volatility. This may result in reduced liquidity of our common stock.
If we cannot continue to satisfy the continuing listing criteria of the Nasdaq Capital Market, the exchange may subsequently delist our common stock.
The market price for our common stock may fluctuate significantly, which could result in substantial losses by our investors.
Sales or the availability for sale of a substantial number of shares of our common stock may cause the price of our common stock to decline and adversely affect our ability to raise capital.
Issuance of additional shares of common stock in future financings will result in the dilution of our existing stockholders and may also result in a reduction in the market price of our common stock.
If securities or industry analysts do not publish research or publish inaccurate or unfavorable research about our business, our stock price and trading volume could decline.
We are subject to financial reporting and other requirements that place significant demands on our resources.
Risks Relating to Our Charter Documents and Capital Structure
A small number of "insider" stockholders have significant influence over stockholder actions.
Provisions of our Certificate of Incorporation and bylaws could discourage potential acquisition proposals and could deter or prevent a change in control.
Delaware law may delay or prevent takeover attempts by third parties and therefore inhibit our stockholders from realizing a premium on their stock.
paragraphs: Investing in our securities involves a variety of risks and uncertainties, known and unknown, including, among others, those discussed below. Each of the following risks should be carefully considered, together with all the other information included in this Form 10-K, including Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations, our consolidated financial statements and the related notes and in our other filings with the SEC. Furthermore, additional risks and uncertainties not presently known to us or that we currently believe to be immaterial may also adversely affect our business. Our business, financial condition, operating results, cash flow and prospects could be materially and adversely affected by any of these risks or uncertainties.

To date, we have not been profitable, and we may never achieve profitability on a full-year or consistent basis. We incurred net losses of $3,077,000 for the year ended December 31, 2025. As of December 31, 2025, we had an accumulated deficit of $103,398,000. If we continue to experience losses, we may not be able to continue our operations, and investors may lose their entire investment.

We continue to pursue business through a variety of channels. These channels may result in the use of a significant amount of our management resources and costs, and we cannot guarantee we will fully realize the expected benefits.

We continue to pursue business through a variety of channels. Although we may devote significant resources and costs to the development of these sales channels, we may struggle to successfully identify the channel partners, or to successfully conclude transactions with the channel partners. Should we be unable to identify, conclude or maintain important channel partnerships, or if our partners are unable to meet our expectations, our business prospects and operations could be adversely affected as a result of the devotion of significant managerial effort and Company costs required. In addition, there can be no assurance that we would fully realize the potential benefit of the relationships. If we cannot do so, we may be unable to meet future revenue expectations.

Our future development will require additional capital, and we may be unable to obtain needed capital or financing on satisfactory terms, or at all, which would prevent us from fully developing our business and generating revenues.

As of December 31, 2025, we had $5.3 million in cash. Our business plan will require additional capital expenditures, and our capital outlays could increase substantially over the next several years as we implement our business plan. As a result, we may need to raise additional capital through future private or public equity offerings, strategic alliances or debt financing. Our future capital requirements will depend on many factors, including, among others: market conditions, sales and marketing costs, mergers and acquisition activity, if any, costs of litigation in enforcing our intellectual property rights, and information technology development and acquisition costs. No assurance can be given that we can successfully raise additional equity or debt capital, or that such financing will be available to us on favorable terms, if at all.

paragraphs: AudioEye is an industry-leading digital accessibility platform delivering Americans with Disabilities Act ("ADA") and Web Content Accessibility Guidelines ("WCAG") compliance at scale. Our solutions advance accessibility with patented technology that reduces barriers, expands access for individuals with disabilities, and enhances the user experience for a broader audience. In 2025, we continued to focus on product innovation and expanding revenue.

We have two sales channels to deliver our product, the Partner and Marketplace channel and the Enterprise channel. AudioEye continues to focus on recurring revenue growth in both channels, while still offering our website and mobile application reporting services and PDF remediation services that provide non-recurring revenue.

For the year ended December 31, 2025, total revenue increased by 15% over the prior year. As of December 31, 2025, Annual Recurring Revenue ("ARR") was approximately $40.0 million, which represented an increase of 9% from December 31, 2024. Refer to "Other Key Operating Metrics" below for details on how we calculate ARR.

As of December 31, 2025, AudioEye had approximately 131,000 customers, an increase from 127,000 customers at December 31, 2024. The increase in customer count was attributable to an increase in customers in our Partner and Marketplace channel.

In the twelve months ended December 31, 2025, revenue from our Partner and Marketplace channel grew 10% over the prior year. This channel represented about 58% of ARR at December 31, 2025. In the twelve months ended December 31, 2025, total Enterprise channel revenue increased by 21% over the prior year. The Enterprise channel represented about 42% of ARR at December 31, 2025.

We had one major customer (including the customer's affiliates reflecting multiple contracts and a partnership with the Company) which accounted for approximately 13% and 15% of our revenue in the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively.

The Company continued to invest in research and development in 2025. Total research and development cost, as defined under the "Research and Development" section in the "Results of Operations" below, was 16% of total revenue in 2025. Total research and development cost decreased from the prior year due to lower personnel cost.

For the year ended December 31, 2025, both selling and marketing expense and general and administrative expense increased over the prior year. The increase in selling and marketing expense was mainly driven by higher investment in third-party marketing services. The increase in general and administrative expense for the year ended December 31, 2025 was due primarily to higher amortization expense associated with our intangible assets, as well as increases in personnel costs, including stock compensation expense, and litigation expenses.
We provide further commentary on our Results of Operation below.

paragraphs: AudioEye 是一個在數位可近性領域領先的平台，提供各價格層面的網站可近性合規解決方案，服務所有規模的企業。我們的解決方案透過專利技術促進可近性，降低障礙，擴展殘障人士的使用權，並提升更廣大用戶的使用體驗。我們相信，當這些解決方案被實施時，企業與機構有機會觸及更多客戶，提升品牌形象，建立更多的品牌忠誠度，最重要的是，為殘障人士這一羣體龐大且持續成長的全球人口提供可近且可用的網路體驗。

AudioEye 主要透過銷售我們軟體即服務（"SaaS"）可近性解決方案的訂閱服務來產生收入。我們的解決方案以機器學習/AI 驅動的技術為基礎，用以發現並修正常見的可近性錯誤。我們的核心與附加解決方案設計用以協助網站與應用程式達到並維持與 AudioEye 對萬維網內容可近性指南（"WCAG"）的解釋所符合的高標準，而 WCAG 是由萬維網聯盟（World Wide Web Consortium）的萬維網可近性倡議（Web Accessibility Initiative）所發佈的網路可近性標準。我們的解決方案有助於降低客戶因數位可近性相關法律行動而產生的成本風險。AudioEye 的客戶可透過 AudioEye 市場處直接購買解決方案，或透過平台夥伴或代理商（例如 Duda）購買，這些平台夥伴或代理商會將我們的解決方案整合至其市場處，或透過垂直內容管理系統（"CMS"）夥伴、經授權的經銷商，或直接與 AudioEye 的銷售團隊合作購買。

AudioEye 在競爭對手之中脫穎而出，是因為我們提供自動化與人為協助的技術解決方案，並持續監測可近性問題，而不需要對網站架構進行根本性的改變。我們認知到單純的自動化無法解決所有可近性問題，因此我們也提供認證的可近性專家，他們可以提供人為協助的技術測試與客製化解決方案。我們的解決方案目前被一些全球最大且最具影響力的公司所信賴，包括 Samsung、Landry's、Calvin Klein 等。政府機構，例如美國聯邦通訊委員會（Federal Communications Commission），也會在其數位平台中使用我們的軟體。我們也與各州及地方的政府機構合作。

如果網站或應用程式未正確編碼，可能會無法為殘障人士提供完整的內容或功能存取，包括使用輔助技術（"AT"）的用戶，例如螢幕閱讀器。因此，這些網站可能會排除潛在的用戶與客戶。如後文更詳細討論，這些網站也可能不符合美國與外國法律要求的可近性與數位包容，例如美國殘障法案第三條（Title III of the Americans with Disabilities Act）、殘障人權法案第 508 條（Section 508 of the Rehabilitation Act）以及加州的 Unruh 民權法案（California's Unruh Civil Rights Act）。
傳統的解決方案在處理網站可近性時可能成本高昂且難以實施。歷史上，達到合規的過程主要由昂貴的諮詢服務驅動，並未充分運用新興科技來降低合規成本負擔或跟上新內容創建的快速節奏。同時，網站可近性努力通常只聚焦於有限的殘障使用案例，導致許多用戶的數位包容需求未被解決。企業可能因認為投資於網站可近性解決方案的回報不足，而對進一步投資有所猶豫，特別是設計與實施全面且可用的合規解決方案所需的投資相當可觀。
其他解決方案已開發用以協助用戶存取網站，但這些解決方案通常需要在用戶電腦上安裝插件或軟體。同樣地，有些解決方案僅針對單一或有限的使用案例進行設計，缺乏全面的解決方案以處理合規與可近性問題。此外，一些公司僅專注於自動化，而我們的解決方案則採用全面的方法，結合科技與專家。
AudioEye 的核心提供持續的測試、自動化修正與 24/7 監測，持續提升與 WCAG 的符合度。這有助於企業與機構符合 WCAG 標準以及適用的美國與外國可近性法律。我們的技術能夠立即識別並修正大多數常見的可近性錯誤，並涵蓋廣泛的殘障類型，包括閱讀障礙、色盲、癲癇等。AudioEye 也提供其他
解決方案以提供增強的合規與可近性，包括定期稽核、專家客製化修正，以及法律支援服務。我們的解決方案可透過訂閱服務以月結方式購買，或以一年或多年期購買。我們也提供 PDF 修復服務與行動應用程式及稽核報告服務，以協助客戶處理其數位可近性需求。
本公司目前及潛在客戶羣包括非常廣泛的私營及公營部門客戶，包括：
● 小型及中型企業； ● 資本公司； ● 非營利機構；
● 聯邦政府機構，其電子及資訊科技必須對殘障人士（包括員工及公眾成員）開放使用，依據1973年復健法案第508條之規定；以及
● 聯邦、州及地方政府與機構，這些機構通常有法律及規範要求對殘障人士提供可近性。

本公司透過兩個主要通路管理客戶，即企業通路與合作夥伴及市場通路。企業通路包括本公司較大型的客戶與機構，包括那些擁有非平台自訂網站的客戶，這些客戶通常會直接與AudioEye銷售人員接洽，以取得自訂價格與解決方案。此通路也包括聯邦、州及地方政府機構。合作夥伴及市場通路包括本公司內容管理系統（CMS）合作夥伴、平台及機構合作夥伴、經授權的經銷商與市場通路。此通路服務於使用合作夥伴或經銷商網際網路主機平台的小型及中型企業，或從本公司市場通路購買AudioEye解決方案的企業。
本公司在截至2025年12月31日及2024年12月31日的會計年度中，有一個主要客戶（包括該客戶的關係企業，反映多個契約及與本公司之合作夥伴關係），其佔本公司營業收入約13%及15%。

headings: 與我們業務及產業相關之風險
本公司有產生重大虧損之歷史，且可能無法達成並維持獲利。
全球經濟條件惡化，包括目前及持續之總體經濟不確定性，可能對本公司產業、業務及營運成果產生不利影響。
本公司目前、過去或未來可能涉及訴訟，此等訴訟可能對本公司財務狀況或營運成果產生重大不利影響。
市場利率可能維持高檔或持續上升，增加未來債務之利息成本，並可能對本公司股票價格產生不利影響。
本公司業務計畫可能無法實現。若本公司業務計畫被證明失敗，本公司業務可能無法持續，您可能喪失全部投資。
人工智慧之進步可能加劇競爭並降低對本公司解決方案之需求。
若本公司無法充分保護本公司專利權，本公司營運可能受到負面影響。
本公司產品與服務所處的現行法律環境仍不明確。
若本公司線上服務市場成長未達預期，將對本公司業務造成不利影響。
本公司之成功取決於員工，部分員工在本公司之職位尚屬較新。
本公司拓展至新產品、服務、技術及地理區域，將使本公司面臨更多商業、法律、財務及競爭風險。
本公司面臨系統中斷及缺乏備援之風險。
政府規範持續演進，不利之變動可能損害本公司業務。
本公司可能面臨與政府契約及相關採購規範相關之風險。
若本公司產品與服務未能持續獲得市場接受，將可能無法籌措未來營運資金。
本公司產品與服務屬高度技術性，可能包含未被發現之錯誤，此情形可能對本公司聲譽造成損害，並對本公司業務產生不利影響。
第三方通訊基礎設施、硬體與軟體之故障，使本公司面臨多種無法控制之風險，這些風險可能對本公司業務造成損害。
安全與隱私權違規、電腦病毒及網路攻擊可能對本公司業務、財務狀況、營運成果或聲譽造成損害。
系統故障或中斷，或本公司未能滿足系統日益增加之需求，可能對本公司業務造成損害。
詐欺、冒名頂替及社會工程學詐騙手法可能導致財務損失或聲譽損害。
本公司預期在可預見之未來不會向普通股股東支付任何紅利，此情形將影響投資者實現其投資未來獲利之程度。
本公司將需要招募並留住更多具備資格之專業人員，以成功拓展本公司業務。
與本公司普通股股票市場相關之風險
雖然本公司普通股已在納斯達克資本市場上市交易，但歷來我們的普通股交易量有限且價格波動較大。這可能會導致本公司普通股流動性降低。
若本公司無法持續符合納斯達克資本市場的持續上市標準，交易所可能隨後將本公司普通股除牌。
本公司普通股的市場價格可能大幅波動，這可能會導致投資人遭受重大損失。
本公司普通股大量銷售或可供銷售，可能會導致本公司普通股價格下跌，並不利於本公司籌資能力。
未來融資中發行額外普通股，將導致現有股東權益稀釋，並可能導致本公司普通股市場價格下降。
若證券或產業分析師未發表研究報告或發表不準確或負面的研究報告，本公司股票價格與交易量可能會下跌。
本公司需遵守財務報告及其他要求，這對本公司資源造成重大壓力。
與本公司章程文件及資本結構相關的風險
少數的「內線」股東對股東行動具有重大影響力。
本公司章程及章程規則的條款可能阻卻潛在收購提案，並可能阻止或防止控制權變更。
特拉華州法律可能延宕或阻止第三方的收購嘗試，因此可能抑制本公司股東實現其股票的 premium。
paragraphs: 投資本公司證券涉及多種風險與不確定性，包括已知與未知的風險，例如下列所討論的風險。每項下列風險應與本Form 10-K所包含的所有其他資訊一併仔細考量，包括管理層對財務狀況與營運結果的討論與分析、我們的合併財務報表與相關附註，以及我們向SEC提交的其他申報文件。此外，尚有其他風險與不確定性，目前我們尚未知悉，或目前認為不重要，也可能對我們的業務產生不利影響。我們的業務、財務狀況、營運結果、現金流量與前景可能因任何這些風險或不確定性而受到重大且不利的影響。
我們持續透過多種管道進行業務拓展。這些管道可能導致我們大量使用管理資源與成本，而我們無法保證我們能完全實現預期的效益。

我們持續透過多種管道進行業務拓展。雖然我們可能投入大量資源與成本用於這些銷售管道的開發，但我們可能難以成功識別這些管道合作夥伴，或成功與這些管道合作夥伴達成交易。倘若我們無法識別、達成或維持重要的管道合作關係，或我們的合作夥伴無法達到我們的期望，則由於需要投入大量管理努力與公司成本，我們的業務前景與營運可能因此受到不利影響。此外，無法保證我們能完全實現這些關係的潛在效益。若我們無法做到，我們可能無法達成未來的收入預期。
我們未來的發展將需要額外資金，我們可能無法以滿意的條件或任何條件取得所需資金或融資，這將阻止我們充分發展業務並產生收入。

截至2025年12月31日，我們持有5.3百萬美元現金。我們的業務計畫將需要額外的資本支出，且我們的資本支出可能在未來幾年大幅增加，因為我們正在執行業務計畫。因此，我們可能需要透過未來的私募或公開股票發行、戰略合作夥伴關係或債務融資來籌集額外資金。我們未來的資金需求將取決於許多因素，包括市場條件、銷售與市場推廣成本、併購活動（如有）、執行我們智慧財產權權利的訴訟成本，以及資訊科技的發展與取得成本。無法保證我們能成功籌集額外的股票或債務資金，或這些融資能以有利條件提供給我們，或是否能提供給我們。
